name: Court of Leaves, Hide the Passage

body.label: Target
body.html: A line of 3 connected spaces within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the line provides concealment. You and one willing ally within 2 units of it may each move 1 unit toward it; enemies use the same concealment.

surges.html: One moved creature suppresses an ordinary sensory penalty until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Fey
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Fey Full Manifestation (FM-2F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
